meowdb_reference.note: MeowDB's community-voted Classic drop list (with votes) and its read-only MSEA list, from the live page. Reference only: monster drop membership comes from Hidden Street (D3-6). item_id is MeowDB's own id for the name in its cached lists (null when the cache does not name it or no local item exists).

discrepancies.note: dropChancePct is a constant MeowDB's report form fills in on submit (100), not an observed meso drop chance. It is never used as a chance: the chance comes from KuroDB (D3-5).

MeowDB's player report (Mesos: 2 per kill | 1 report) is kept, following the brief's "do not replace MeowDB values when MeowDB provides them". This is the orchestrator's inference recorded with D3-5, not an owner decision: the owner's chosen option left the Snail as an open question.

membership.version_note: Front page, 'Before Chaos', posted 21 June 2011: 'This site is archived directly from our GMS database ... with its Big Bang updates and changes.' It is post-Big-Bang GMS (v0.96 era), a different game version from MapleStory Classic World (MeowDB). Its stats differ from MeowDB's (Snail HP 15 here, 45 on MeowDB).

meowdb_reference.item_ids.note: MeowDB item ids for the reference lists, matched by name within MeowDB's own cached drop list and the cached page's MSEA list (https://meowdb.com/msclassic/monsters/2)

notes: Membership: Hidden Street's "Before Chaos" drop lists (https://bc.hidden-street.net/monster/snail, read 2026-10-05T08:03:43.486Z): post-Big-Bang GMS v0.96, a different game version from MapleStory Classic, used by the project owner's decision D3-6. Every member stays in entries; one without a KuroDB chance or a local item never rolls.

Chance: KuroDB (https://playkuro.com/database/#monsters/100100, read 2026-10-05T07:46:19.383Z, "Updated 10/2/2026"), only for members its page also lists, joined by name through tools/sources/crosswalk/drop_items.json (D3-4). KuroDB "

% base" is the chance before any server-wide drop-rate multiplier; MisoStory applies none (multiplier 1).
excluded_kuro_only: KuroDB rows for this monster that no member matches. They never drop (KuroDB never adds a member, D3-6).

Runtime (contract C1): an entry rolls only when chance_state is resolved, item_id is not null and quest_gate is null or its quest is in progress. The meso bag rolls only when its amount and chance are both resolved; the amount is a uniform integer in [min, max].
